hugin_as_text:
select cast(uid as string) as v from (
select '15/9-F-15 D' as uid, '41000' as serial, '1,5' as num, '-999.25' as sentinel union all
select '15/9-F-4'   as uid, '39600' as serial, ' 12 345,6 ' as num, '-999.25' as sentinel union all
select '15/9-F-11 T2' as uid, '43000' as serial, 'nan' as num, '-9999' as sentinel union all
select 'NO 15/9-F-1 C' as uid, '39630' as serial, '3.25' as num, '-999.2500' as sentinel
) t order by 1

hugin_date_from_iso: select cast(try_cast(substr(iso, 1, 10) as date) as date) as v from (  select '2016-08-04T00:00:00+02:00' as iso union all  select '2013-04-01T00:00:00+01:00' as iso union all  select 'not a timestamp' as iso) t order by 1
hugin_to_number:

    nullif(
      replace(
        replace(trim(cast(num as string)), ' ', ''),
        ',', '.'
      ),
      ''
    ) as double
  ) as v from (
select '15/9-F-15 D' as uid, '41000' as serial, '1,5' as num, '-999.25' as sentinel union all
select '15/9-F-4'   as uid, '39600' as serial, ' 12 345,6 ' as num, '-999.25' as sentinel union all

hugin_month_key: select cast((extract(year from date '2014-04-07') * 100 + extract(month from date '2014-04-07')) as bigint) as v
hugin_date_key:
select cast((extract(year from date '2014-04-07') * 10000
   + extract(month from date '2014-04-07') * 100
   + extract(day from date '2014-04-07')) as bigint) as v

hugin_seconds_between:
select timestampdiff(SECOND, prev_ts, ts) as v from (  select ts, lag(ts) over (order by ts) as prev_ts from (
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:00:00' as ts, 12.0 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:03:00' as ts, 18.5 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:07:30' as ts, 11.0 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:19:00' as ts, 25.5 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:24:00' as ts, 25.5 as block_position_m
) s) w where prev_ts is not null order by 1
hugin_minutes_preceding:
select cast(travel as double) as v from (  select max(block_position_m) over (    order by ts range between interval 10 minutes preceding and current row  ) - min(block_position_m) over (    order by ts range between interval 10 minutes preceding and current row  ) as travel  from (
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:00:00' as ts, 12.0 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:03:00' as ts, 18.5 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:07:30' as ts, 11.0 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:19:00' as ts, 25.5 as block_position_m union all
select timestamp '2016-08-04 10:24:00' as ts, 25.5 as block_position_m
) s) w order by 1
hugin_date_spine: select concat('rows=', cast(count(*) as string)) as v from (select explode(sequence(date '2008-06-01', date '2016-09-30', interval 1 day)) as calendar_date) spine union all select concat('min=', cast(min(calendar_date) as string)) from (select explode(sequence(date '2008-06-01', date '2016-09-30', interval 1 day)) as calendar_date) spine union all select concat('max=', cast(max(calendar_date) as string)) from (select explode(sequence(date '2008-06-01', date '2016-09-30', interval 1 day)) as calendar_date) spine
